note: Snapshot used to price steps; its sha256 is recorded on every step as cost.pricing_snapshot_hash and the bytes are stored in the BlobStore at startup. Models not listed are priced 0 and marked priced=false. Override with AGENTOS_ANTHROPIC_PRICING=/path/to/pricing.json.
free_prefixes_note: Locally served open-weight families behind Ollama's /v1/messages are priced 0 and marked priced=true.
